summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of the Italian bakery app (Impasto). 6/6 pytest backend tests passed (auth guards, recipes CRUD + category filter, upload/download, AI suggest via GPT-5.4-mini). Frontend auth-gated UI validated end-to-end by seeding a session_token cookie in Mongo test_database: /dashboard, /calcolatore, /ricette, /ricette/nuova all render, save recipe -> redirect to /ricette/:id detail with Modifica/Stampa/Elimina buttons. Dough math verified live in UI: pieces=4, piece_weight=250, hyd=65, salt=2.5, yeast=0.3 => Farina 595.9g, Acqua 387.4g, Sale 14.9g, Lievito 1.8g (matches 1000*100/167.8 formula).

issues: data-testids tab-impasto/tab-farine/tab-lievitazione, flour-blend, leavening-planner are NOT present on Calculator page (tabs render text 'Impasto | Farine (W) | Lievitazione' but without data-testid). They exist on RecipeForm. Consider adding them for consistent automation coverage.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid=tab-impasto/tab-farine/tab-lievitazione and flour-blend/leavening-planner on /calcolatore Calculator page to match spec. Currently only present on /ricette/nuova RecipeForm.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_user reads Bearer token cleanly and cookie via request.cookies; works via both paths.
create_session sets cookie with SameSite=None; Secure=True; httpOnly=True (correct for cross-site preview).
MongoDB _id excluded from all reads via projection {"_id": 0} - good.
All /api routes protected by Depends(get_current_user) - good.
doughMath.js baker-percentage engine correctness confirmed numerically in UI.
Frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via axios with withCredentials:true - good.
test_credentials: Emergent Google OAuth only. Seeded test session in Mongo test_database per /app/auth_testing.md (bearer + cookie both accepted).
seed_data_creation: Session-scoped fixture inserts a user + user_session and cleans up recipes/user/session after tests. Also seeded a session for FE cookie testing (cleanup left to next iteration).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_bakery_api.py is reusable. It seeds/cleans up its own session. Use `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_bakery_api.py -v` from /app. For frontend, seed a session_token in Mongo, then add cookie {name:session_token, domain:preview host, sameSite:None, secure:true, httpOnly:false} and navigate.
rca of the issue: No critical issues. Only minor: some spec-referenced data-testids (tab-impasto/tab-farine/tab-lievitazione/flour-blend/leavening-planner) are missing on the Calculator page but present on RecipeForm.
